messages:
sam: quick follow-up after the auth token postmortem. need owners/timelines for validation tests, audit fields, and rotation cadence. keeping it tight so these don't slip.
ivy: I can own validation tests and CI gate. plan: e2e that rotates keys and asserts zero 401s for 5m. ETA: 4d.
noah: i'll take audit enrichment. will add auth.rotation event with kid, initiator, method, and service_id. retention: 90d hot. ETA: 3d.
carla: ops will handle rotation cadence + deploy behavior. prefer SIGHUP reload + phased rollouts. i'll draft playbook. ETA: 1w.
infra-bot: created ticket TKT-11022: "auth-rotation-remediations" (https://issues.redwood/TKT-11022)
sam: proposed alerts: rotation.auth_error_rate > 0.5% over 10m -> page oncall and create follow-up. also daily digest to #incidents for 7 days post-rollout.
ivy: i'll add CI job + smoke test and link PR to TKT-11022 when green.
noah: will post mapping + sample kibana queries to the ticket.
carla: will update deploy controller to phased rollout for critical services and add a reload handler.
sam: summary: ivy: e2e + CI (4d) | noah: audit event + view (3d) | carla: playbook + reload + rollout plan (1w) | sam: alerts + digests + coord (2d). owners, please update TKT-11022 with blockers/ETAs.
infra-bot: reminder scheduled: status sync in 5 days.
sam: thanks, team.
